user.title: Add vehicle
user.description: Link an existing odometer sensor to track mileage automatically. Without one, you enter readings manually or via fuel logs.

abort.already_configured: A vehicle with this name already exists.

user.title: Add service item
user.description: Set a day interval, a km interval, or both. The item is due when either is reached.

reconfigure.title: Edit service item
reconfigure.description: Set a day interval, a km interval, or both. The item is due when either is reached.

error.interval_required: Set a day interval, a km interval, or both.

user.title: Select categories
user.description: Choose which kinds of service items to browse. You pick the individual items in the next step. Only items that fit this vehicle's drive type are offered.

select_items.title: Select service items
select_items.description: Pick the items to add, with their typical interval. Items marked • exists are already set up; importing them again creates duplicates.

configure.title: When were they last done?
configure.description: Used as the starting point for the due dates of all imported items. Leave it empty if you don't know; tracking by distance then starts at the current mileage. You can edit each item afterwards.

error.no_categories_selected: Please select at least one category.
error.no_items_selected: Please select at least one item.

abort.catalog_empty: There are no catalog items for this vehicle.
abort.no_items_found: No items found in the selected categories.

monthly_cost.name: Fuel and charging cost this month

not_vehicle_entity.message: {entity_id} is not an entity of the Vehicle integration.

vehicle_not_loaded.message: The vehicle of {entity_id} is not loaded.

not_service_entity.message: {entity_id} does not belong to a service item.

odometer_decrease.message: The new odometer reading is lower than the current one. Enable allow_decrease to override.

no_fuel_vehicle.message: This vehicle is electric. Use add_charge instead.

no_electric_vehicle.message: This vehicle cannot be charged. Use add_fuel instead.

price_required.message: Provide a price per unit or a total cost.

receipt_too_large.message: The file is larger than 15 MB.

receipt_unsupported.message: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP and PDF files are supported.

receipt_upload_missing.message: The uploaded file was not found. Upload it again.

ai_task_unavailable.message: No AI task is available. Set up an AI provider with AI task support in Home Assistant.

attach_target_missing.message: Provide a log entry id, or use an entity of a service item.

attach_target_not_found.message: The log entry or service completion does not exist.

set_odometer.name: Set odometer
set_odometer.description: Sets the manual odometer reading. Ignored while a linked odometer sensor reports a value.

allow_decrease.name: Allow decrease
allow_decrease.description: Allow a reading lower than the current one.

total_cost.name: Total cost
total_cost.description: Total paid. If no price per liter is given, the price is derived from this.

price_per_liter.name: Price per liter
price_per_liter.description: Unit price. Recorded for price trends; the total is derived from it if no total cost is given.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Odometer reading in km. Needed for consumption statistics.

total_cost.name: Total cost
total_cost.description: Total paid. If no price per kWh is given, the price is derived from this.

price_per_kwh.name: Price per kWh
price_per_kwh.description: Unit price. Recorded for price trends; the total is derived from it if no total cost is given.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Odometer reading in km. Needed for consumption statistics.

complete_service.name: Complete service
complete_service.description: Records a service item as done.

entity_id.name: Service item entity
entity_id.description: Any entity of the service item.

upload_receipt.name: Upload receipt
upload_receipt.description: Stores a file uploaded through Home Assistant (photo or PDF) and returns a receipt id to attach to an entry. Unattached receipts are deleted after 24 hours.

file.name: File
file.description: Photo or PDF of the receipt.

scan_receipt.name: Scan receipt
scan_receipt.description: Reads date, amounts and prices from a receipt with an AI task entity. Returns the values for you to confirm; nothing is saved.

ai_task_entity_id.name: AI task entity
ai_task_entity_id.description: Defaults to the preferred AI task entity.

attach_receipt.name: Attach receipt
attach_receipt.description: Attaches a receipt to an existing log entry, or to the latest completion of a service item.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity of the vehicle, or of the service item when no log entry is given.

log_entry_id.name: Log entry id
log_entry_id.description: Id from the activity attribute of the odometer sensor.

delete_log_entry.name: Delete log entry
delete_log_entry.description: Deletes a fuel or charge entry together with its receipt. delete_activity does the same and also handles services.

log_entry_id.name: Log entry id
log_entry_id.description: Id from the activity attribute of the odometer sensor.

update_activity.name: Update activity
update_activity.description: Changes a past refuel, charge or completed service. Only the given fields change. Use the id from the activity attribute of the odometer sensor.

activity_id.name: Activity id
activity_id.description: Id from the activity attribute of the odometer sensor.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Liters or kWh (refuel and charge). The cost is recalculated from the price.

price.name: Price per unit
price.description: Price per liter or kWh (refuel and charge). The cost is recalculated unless a total cost is given.

total_cost.name: Total cost
total_cost.description: Total paid (refuel and charge). Without a price, the price is derived from it.

receipt.name: Receipt
receipt.description: Receipt id (from upload_receipt) to attach. A previous receipt is deleted.

delete_activity.name: Delete activity
delete_activity.description: Deletes a past refuel, charge or completed service together with its receipt.

activity_id.name: Activity id
activity_id.description: Id from the activity attribute of the odometer sensor.
